domain-information: A Client identifies repetitive tasks in their workflow and requests a review to find automation opportunities
A Client provides process documentation to help the consultant understand current operations
An Automation Consultant analyzes workflows and recommends suitable automation solutions to improve efficiency
An Automation Consultant designs a workflow automation plan and demonstrates it to the client for approval
An Automation Consultant sets up automation scripts and connects systems to reduce manual work
An Automation Consultant monitors automated processes and adjusts settings to optimize performance
A System Administrator configures software permissions to ensure automated tasks run securely
A System Administrator supervises automation workflows to prevent disruption to daily operations
A Client reviews performance reports from the automation tools to assess time and cost savings
A Client provides feedback to the consultant to refine the automation and add new capabilities

domain objects.name: Client
domain objects.description: Person or organization requesting workflow automation

domain objects.name: Review Request
domain objects.description: Initial request to examine tasks and processes for automation potential

domain objects.name: Task
domain objects.description: Individual activity within the client’s workflow

domain objects.name: Process Documentation
domain objects.description: Material describing how the client’s current workflow operates

domain objects.name: Automation Consultant
domain objects.description: Specialist who analyzes workflows and designs automation

domain objects.name: Workflow Analysis
domain objects.description: Evaluation of client workflows to identify automation opportunities

domain objects.name: Workflow Automation Plan
domain objects.description: Proposed setup for automating parts of the workflow

domain objects.name: Automation Script
domain objects.description: Executable automation logic that performs tasks automatically

domain objects.name: System Administrator
domain objects.description: Person managing system permissions and operational stability

domain objects.name: Software Permission
domain objects.description: Access settings required for automation scripts to run

domain objects.name: Workflow Supervision
domain objects.description: Oversight activity ensuring automated workflows run smoothly

domain objects.name: Performance Report
domain objects.description: Summary of automation results and efficiency gains

domain objects.name: Automation Feedback
domain objects.description: Client input about improvements or issues with the automation

associations.description: Automation Consultant performs the Workflow Analysis
Workflow Analysis is based on the Review Request
Automation Consultant prepares the Workflow Automation Plan
Workflow Analysis informs the Workflow Automation Plan
Workflow Automation Plan is presented to the Client
Automation Script produces the Performance Report
System Administrator configures the Software Permission
Software Permission enables the Automation Script
System Administrator carries out the Workflow Supervision
Workflow Supervision monitors the Automation Script
Automation Feedback is sent to the Automation Consultant
